newsitem.title: USA: NextLevel Systems Inc Q2 oper net.
newsitem.headline: NextLevel Systems Inc Q2 oper net.

text.p: (Unaudited - In Thousands, Except Per Share Information)
Three Months Ended Three Months Ended

(A) - Pro forma information reflects (i) the number of common shares issued and common equivalent shares existing at the date of the spin-off, (ii) an additional $1.8 million of selling, general and administrative costs reflecting a full allocation of corporate overhead in both 1997 and 1996, and (iii) at the beginning of each period presented, a net debt level of $100 million.

(B) - Excluding the $21.5 million ($15.6 million net of tax) of charges related to the restructuring (primarily employee costs related to the split of the company's Taiwan operations and costs directly related to the spin-off), pro forma operating income and pro forma net income would have been $32.2 million and $17.6 million ($.12 per pro forma share), respectively for the three months ended June 30, 1997. These costs include $15.6 million charged to cost of sales and $5.9 million charged to selling, general and administrative expense.

(C) - Excluding the $141 million ($91.6 million net of tax) of charges related to the NLC litigation costs, pro forma operating income and pro forma net income would have been $14 million and $7.5 million ($.05 per pro forma share), respectively for the three months ended June 30, 1996.
